summary.text: Lorissa Sweet is a Republican member of the Indiana House of Representatives who represents District 50, assumed office on November 9, 2022, and is the incumbent in the November 3, 2026 general election for that seat.
Ballotpedia lists Pepper Snyder (D) as the other candidate on the general election ballot.

paragraphs.text: Lorissa Sweet lives in Wabash, Indiana, and earned a B.S. in animal agribusiness from Purdue University in 2001.
Her career experience includes owning and working as a pet groomer with Sweet Grooms.
Sweet succeeded Daniel Leonard (R) in District 50.
For 2025-2026, Ballotpedia lists her on the Agriculture and Rural Development, Family, Children and Human Affairs, and House Local Government committees.
